expectedIssues: The "Tokumaru Ramen Bar" heading is cut off mid-word, rendering as "Tokumaru Ramei" with no ellipsis
reportedIssues: The restaurant title in the first 'Popular right now' card reads 'Tokumaru Ramei' — the text is cut off mid-character (no ellipsis) where it collides with the right-aligned star rating '4.8 (500+)'. This is a full-width vertical card, not a horizontal carousel, so the truncation is a real layout bug.

The favourite heart button on the ramen card uses a white/light circular background with a dark outline, while the heart button on the pizza card below uses a dark/black circular background. The inconsistent treatment makes the second button low-contrast and looks unintentional.

The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a very light grey background while the neighbouring thumbnails are dark, making the row look visually inconsistent and the light image appear unloaded/placeholder-like.
